result_summary.title: Identity Vault: Wrong data display and HTTP 403 errors for 2 users
result_summary.description: Two users in the ME production environment are encountering HTTP 403 errors and seeing incorrect data within Identity Vault. This appears to be an access grant issue. The business impact is currently low given the limited number of affected users, but we need it resolved.
